python3 -c "
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tests/codegen/objects/property_access/nullsafe.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''    assert!(
        out.diagnostics.contains(\"Warning: Attempt to read property \\\\\"name\\\\\" on null\"),
        \"{}\",
        out.diagnostics
    assert_eq!(
        out.stderr, \"\",
        \"\\\`??\\\` must suppress the mid-chain property-on-null warning\"
    );'''
new = '''    // The two sides of the merge asserted OPPOSITE things here: upstream that the warning is
    // raised, this branch that \\\`??\\\` suppresses it. The suppression is what \\\`php -n\\\` 8.5.6 does
    // for this exact program — it prints \\\`fallback\\\` and raises nothing — which is also what the
    // test is named for.
    assert_eq!(
        out.diagnostics, \"\",
        \"\\\`??\\\` must suppress the mid-chain property-on-null warning\"
    );'''
assert t.count(old) == 1, t.count(old)
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new))
print('nullsafe.rs: contradictory assertions resolved on the measured behaviour')
